title: Stalk and structure-sheaf comparison from stage prime localizations
statement:
Let $Z=(|Z|,\mathcal O_Z)$ be a locally ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], put $C=\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$, and let $j:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] be the morphism corresponding to $\mathrm{id}_C$ under [lem-a1-locally-ringed-space-affine-adjunction]. Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed partially ordered set, let $(A_i,r_{ik})_{i\leq k}$ be a directed system of commutative rings, and let $r_i:A_i\to C$ be compatible homomorphisms making $C$ its colimit in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For $z\in Z$, write $\mathfrak q_z=j(z)\subset C$ and $\mathfrak p_{i,z}=r_i^{-1}(\mathfrak q_z)\subset A_i$. Assume that for every $z$ and $i$ the homomorphism induced by the germ map $A_i\xrightarrow{r_i}C\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$,
$$(A_i)_{\mathfrak p_{i,z}}\longrightarrow\mathcal O_{Z,z},$$
is an isomorphism, where prime localizations are as in [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then for every $z$ the stalk homomorphism
$$j_z^\sharp:\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}C,\mathfrak q_z}\longrightarrow\mathcal O_{Z,z}$$
is an isomorphism, equivalently the germ-induced map $C_{\mathfrak q_z}\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$ is an isomorphism. Moreover, if the underlying map of $j$ is a homeomorphism onto a subset $F\subseteq|\operatorname{Spec}C|$ with its subspace topology, the morphism $j$ factors as an isomorphism of locally ringed spaces
$$Z\xrightarrow{\sim}(F,\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}C}|_F)$$
followed by the canonical inclusion of the ringed subspace [def-a1-ringed-subspace]. The isomorphism uses the factorization of the sheaf map of $j$, not a separate choice of structure sheaf on $F$.

source.place: Tag 0API, lemma-sits-in-functions, proof, sentence beginning "For any e" and its structure-sheaf identification, with the localization and stalk-criterion details exposed (old parent steps 5 and 6)

proof.text: Fix z, put C = Gamma(Z), B = O_Z,z, q = j(z), and S = O_Spec(C),q. The spectrum stalk is a localization of C at q [lem-weil-pbc-spec-domain-stalks-function-field]. The germ square of the affine adjunction [lem-a1-locally-ringed-space-affine-adjunction] identifies the composite C -> S -> B with the global germ. For each i, use the universal property [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] to construct k_i : (A_i)_(r_i^-1 q) -> S extending r_i. Localization uniqueness shows that j_z sharp composed with k_i equals the assumed isomorphism theta_i.

source.place: Tags 01HV (lemma-spec-sheaves), part (6), and 01I1 (lemma-morphism-into-affine), germ square in its proof

proof.text: Surjectivity of j_z sharp follows from any one theta_i, since I is nonempty. For injectivity take x in S in its kernel, and write x times s = c with s outside q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Represent the numerator c = r_i(a) using the filtered-colimit elementwise representation theorem [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise] and the given colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The image of a in the stage localization maps to zero under theta_i, hence is zero. Applying k_i gives c = 0 in S. The image of s is a unit, so x = 0. Thus the actual stalk map is bijective and is an isomorphism of commutative rings. Compose with the spectrum stalk-localization isomorphism to obtain the second displayed stalk isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0API (lemma-sits-in-functions), sentence beginning "For any e"; elementary assembly of the localized cocone

proof.text: Given the homeomorphism h onto F, let i be the subspace inclusion and use exactly the inverse-image sheaf O_F of [def-a1-ringed-subspace]. The inverse-image stalk isomorphism and its germ formula [lem-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image-stalk] show that the canonical inclusion has isomorphisms on stalks. Transfer the local-ring structures along these isomorphisms to obtain the stated locallyRingedSubspace and its local inclusion. Transport the sheaf map of j along the equality h followed by i = j on spaces. Apply the inverse-image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] to obtain alpha and hence the ringed-space map f over h. The adjunction unit equation shows f followed by the canonical inclusion equals j, including the sheaf map.

source.place: Tag 008H (lemma-stalk-pullback), and the inverse-image adjunction preceding it; applied to the ringed subspaces of Tag 0API

proof.text: The composition formula for stalk maps of ringed-space morphisms [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], applied to the factorization equation, expresses j_z sharp as the inclusion stalk isomorphism followed by f_z sharp. Cancel the inclusion isomorphism to see that all stalk maps of f are isomorphisms. The sheaf stalk criterion [lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-iso-on-stalks], with the ring-valued form supplied by Mathlib via [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise], implies that a sheafed-space map over the homeomorphism h with these stalk maps is an isomorphism. In Lean use SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_stalk_iso and .to_iso: h is an open embedding and an isomorphism of topological spaces.

proof.text: Lift the sheafed-space isomorphism to a locally ringed space isomorphism using LocallyRingedSpace.isoOfSheafedSpaceIso [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Its maps on stalks are ring isomorphisms, hence local. The local inclusion constructed above has underlying sheafed-space morphism exactly ringedSubspaceι [def-a1-ringed-subspace]. Faithfulness of the forgetful functor transfers the already proved factorization equation to locally ringed spaces.

lean.statement: theorem affinization_localization_stalk_criterion (Z : LocallyRingedSpace.{u}) {I : Type u} [PartialOrder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (A : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (r : A ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (Γ.obj (op Z))) (_hcolim : IsColimit (Cocone.mk (Γ.obj (op Z)) r)) (_hstage : ∀ (z : Z) (i : I), ∃ θ : CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime ((Z.toΓSpecFun z).comap (r.app i).hom).asIdeal) ⟶ Z.presheaf.stalk z, CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A.obj i) (Localization.AtPrime ((Z.toΓSpecFun z).comap (r.app i).hom).asIdeal)) ≫ θ = r.app i ≫ Z.presheaf.Γgerm z ∧ IsIso θ) : (∀ z : Z, IsIso (Z.toΓSpec.stalkMap z) ∧ IsIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (StructureSheaf.stalkIso (Γ.obj (op Z)) (Z.toΓSpecFun z)).toRingHom ≫ Z.toΓSpec.stalkMap z)) ∧ (∀ (F : Set (Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (Γ.obj (op Z)))) (h : Z ≃ₜ F), (∀ z : Z, (h z).val = Z.toΓSpec.base z) → ∃ hlocal : ∀ x : F, IsLocalRing ((ringedSubspace (Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (Γ.obj (op Z))) F).presheaf.stalk x), ∃ (e : Z ≅ locallyRingedSubspace (Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (Γ.obj (op Z))) F hlocal) (ι : locallyRingedSubspace (Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (Γ.obj (op Z))) F hlocal ⟶ Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (Γ.obj (op Z))), ι.toShHom = ringedSubspaceι (Spec.locallyRingedSpaceObj (Γ.obj (op Z))) F ∧ e.hom ≫ ι = Z.toΓSpec)
